name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task 'Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off' is a conditional rule, not a goal. Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) hard captures it exactly: whenever the siren is ringing (a lasting condition), a switch toggle is owed, and the toggle is what ends the ringing. Each new ring re-arms the debt, so every ring must be turned off, as the machine's u0/u1 loop shows. The rule-only warning is valid since siren_ringing is a condition of an 'each time' rule, not a commanded event.

texts: Each time the siren is ringing, toggle the switch to turn it off.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
